title: The AI Chip Stock You've Never Heard Of: Qnity Up 100%

beats.narration: There's a stock up 100% since November you've never heard of. It's called Qnity, ticker QNTY.
Qnity was spun off from DuPont in November 2025, and it supplies the chemicals every advanced chip fab needs to actually make silicon work.
Photoresists, etch chemicals, deposition materials — TSMC, Samsung, and Intel are all customers.
Q1 earnings just blew past expectations: $1.08 per share versus $0.92 consensus, and revenue hit $1.32 billion.
Even after doubling, Wall Street keeps hiking price targets. It's a hidden link in the AI-chip supply chain.
Follow for the small-cap names moving the AI trade before they hit the headlines.
